bio: With 17+ years of experience in Dermatology and Cosmetology, Dr. Daksha Patel is dedicated to providing personalised, evidence-based care for healthy, confident skin and hair. Her special areas of interest include acne and pigmentation, hair problems, anti-ageing treatments, and paediatric dermatology.
With extensive clinical experience and a patient-first approach, she focuses on understanding each individual's concerns and creating treatment plans tailored to their unique needs.

Dr. Patel holds an MD (Skin & VD), a postgraduate degree in dermatology. She has treated over 3,00,000 patients and performed more than 10,000 cosmetic treatments, and consults at Skin Essence in Kalyani Nagar, Pune.
